description: AI brand visibility, quick check: how often an AI assistant recommends a brand for buyer questions in its category (5 prompts, 1 engine). Use for a fast, cheap read on whether ChatGPT-style assistants mention a brand before paying for the full report. Returns score 0-100, per-engine visibility, share of voice vs competitors, missed prompts, cited domains and recommendations. Price: $0.50 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

category.description: Product category the prompts are about, e.g. note-taking apps

engines.description: Subset of openai, anthropic, google, perplexity; default every engine that is enabled

promptCount.description: Prompts to ask, capped by the tier

prompts.description: Your own buyer questions instead of generated ones

name: ai_visibility_quick

avgRank.description: Average 0-based rank when mentioned, lower is better; null if never mentioned

firstMentionRate.description: % of prompts where the brand is named first

visibility.description: % of prompts where the brand appears

missedPrompts.description: Prompts where a competitor was named and the brand was not

namedByAi.description: Names the engines brought up on their own

answer.description: The engine's answer, cut to 1,200 characters

score.description: 0-100 composite: 60% visibility, 25% rank quality, 15% first mention

topCitedDomains.description: Sites the engines cite for this category
